definitions.explanation: question word used with the counter {枚|まい} to ask about the quantity of flat, thin objects such as paper, photos, clothes, plates, CDs, etc.

examples.japanese: ⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{何枚|なんまい}⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{何枚|なんまい}⟦{撮|と}りました→撮る：00760_toru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: How many photos did you take?

examples.japanese: ⟦ピザ→ピザ：06769_piza⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{何枚|なんまい}⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}します→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: How many pizzas shall we order?

notes:
COUNTER QUESTION:
{何枚|なんまい} combines ⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧ (what/how many) with the counter ⟦{枚|まい}→〜枚：00650_mai⟧ for flat objects.

OBJECTS COUNTED WITH {枚|まい}:
- ⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧/⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧ - paper/documents
- ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧ - photos
- ⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧/Tシャツ - shirts/T-shirts
- ⟦{皿|さら}→皿：00883_sara⟧ - plates
- CD/DVD - CDs/DVDs
- ⟦チケット→チケット：11014_chiketto⟧ - tickets
- ⟦ピザ→ピザ：06769_piza⟧ - pizza
- ⟦{板|いた}→板：01792_ita⟧/{板|ばん} - boards

RELATED COUNTER QUESTIONS:
- ⟦{何冊|なんさつ}→何冊：08778_nansatsu⟧ - how many (books)
- ⟦{何杯|なんばい}→何杯：08779_nanbai⟧/{何杯|なんぱい} - how many (cups)
- {何本|なんぼん} - how many (long objects)
- ⟦{何個|なんこ}→何個：26687_nanko⟧ - how many (small items)
